name: Gabriel M. Perry
headline: Ph.D. student in Computer Science at Brigham Young University
affiliation: Information and Decision Algorithms (IDeA) Labs, BYU
about: I am a computer science Ph.D. student at Brigham Young University and a researcher in IDeA Labs. My work sits at the intersection of control theory, mathematical modeling, algorithms, and cyber-physical system security.

I am especially interested in how mathematical structure can reveal vulnerabilities, simplify computation, and support robust decisions in complex networked systems. My recent work includes algorithms for matrix inverse entries, control-theoretic security questions, and collaborative work in resource allocation and geospatial anomaly detection.
